verdict: Organic visibility is declining across all three locations; paid channels are inactive.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, all engagement this period came exclusively from Google Business Profile and organic search — no paid campaigns ran on Meta or Google Ads at any location. Combined, your three locations generated 382 GBP actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) over the last 28 days, but the most recent 7 days show sharp drops at every location: Advance Grinding down 71%, Forte Metals down 55%, and O'Hare Precision down 39%. The organic search picture is moving in the same direction, with Search Console clicks falling 42–44% week-over-week at the locations where data is tracked. SEO root-cause work is underway with a fix targeted by August 31, and outreach contact pulls are scheduled for the same date to re-engage lapsed accounts while organic visibility is being restored.
